entries.title: Plan coverage before production

inputs.purpose: Approved layout, entrances, exits, and light direction.

entries.outputIntent: Declare the master, reverses, inserts, and reaction coverage before generating takes.
guidance: Choose counter-angles when dialogue or cross-room action needs them.
Keep all planned views on one geography, exposure, palette, and axis.
verifyCriteria: Every required reverse has a declared spatial source.
The coverage plan includes the reactions or details needed by the cut.
incompatibilities: Late free-text invention of a reverse view.

entries.title: Axis and eyeline lock

inputs.purpose: Subject positions, look directions, and the established line of action.

entries.outputIntent: Preserve readable look direction and screen direction across cuts.
guidance: Name the axis from world geometry and bind each setup to one side.
If the axis changes, show the crossing or re-establish geography before the next reverse.
verifyCriteria: A direction change is motivated and visible.

entries.title: Continuity state ledger

inputs.purpose: Shots in story order with their approved project references.

entries.outputIntent: Track state changes independently from generation order.
guidance: Record identity state, wardrobe, props, weather, time, light direction, screen direction, and recent emotional context per shot.
Represent a persistent change with a new approved state asset rather than an adjective.
verifyCriteria: Each shot resolves to an explicit current state.
Every state change has an approved cause and new source of truth.
incompatibilities: Project facts stored only in global library text.

entries.title: Match-action coverage

inputs.purpose: The approved motion or gaze that crosses the edit.

entries.outputIntent: Bind adjacent shots through a shared action state or attention cue.
guidance: Declare the outgoing and incoming state around the cut.
Use inserts or reactions when exact continuous motion is less reliable than the story beat.
verifyCriteria: The cut preserves motion direction and causal order.
A rescue preserves the same beat when direct continuity fails.
incompatibilities: A cut that resets the subject without a visible transition.

entries.title: Separate review passes

inputs.purpose: The complete take and its declared acceptance criteria.

entries.outputIntent: Inspect one failure class at a time before approving a take.
guidance: Review identity, continuity, timing, camera, physical contact, and audio in separate full-length passes.
Record the exact failing criterion instead of collapsing the result into a general quality judgment.
verifyCriteria: The take was watched through for every configured pass.
Acceptance cites the current shot criteria and canon.
incompatibilities: Approval based only on a thumbnail or first seconds.

provenance.adaptation: Rewritten as project-system-agnostic coverage and continuity recipes; platform tools and limits were excluded.
